earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 lvs_ex991x09302026.htm EX-99.1 Document EXHIBIT 99.1 Las Vegas Sands Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results For the quarter ended September 30, 2026 • Net Revenue $3.22 billion • Net Income $352 million • Diluted Earnings per Share $0.48 • Consolidated Adjusted Property EBITDA $1.12 billion • LVS Repurchased $950 million of Common Stock During the Quarter • LVS Board of Directors Announced a 20% Increase in LVS’s Recurring Common Stock Dividend for the 2027 Calendar Year, Raising the Annual Dividend to $1.44 per Share ($0.36 per Share per Quarter) LAS VEGAS, October 21, 2026 - Las Vegas Sands (NYSE: LVS), the leading global developer and operator of Integrated Resorts, today reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. “We continued to execute our strategic objectives during the quarter in both Singapore and Macao while increasing the return of capital to shareholders, including through the repurchase of $950 million of our common stock during the quarter,” said Patrick Dumont, chairman and chief executive officer. “At Marina Bay Sands in Singapore, we delivered solid financial performance. We remain enthusiastic about our growth prospects in Singapore both today and upon the completion of our ongoing expansion project, which will meaningfully increase our suite capacity and entertainment offerings, including through the introduction of an arena designed to be the most important entertainment venue in the region. “We are encouraged by our progress in Macao during the quarter, with our ongoing investments in enhanced service and hospitality offerings contributing to growth in volumes across all gaming segments as compared to the prior year. “We remain confident in our long-term strategy in both Singapore and Macao and will continue to invest in future growth. We are fortunate to have the balance sheet and cash flow strength to support our meaningful capital investment programs, positioning our portfolio of properties to capitalize on the growing demand for premium travel and world-class entertainment experiences in the region. “We strongly believe that our people, our products and our focus on delivering outstanding service, hospitality and entertainment experiences to our customers will drive growth for the company and deliver strong returns to our shareholders in the years ahead.” Net revenue was $3.22 billion, compared to $3.33 billion in the prior year quarter. Operating income was $618 million, compared to $719 million in the prior year quarter. Net income in the third quarter of 2026 was $352 million, compared to $491 million in the third quarter of 2025. Consolidated adjusted property EBITDA was $1.12 billion, compared to $1.34 billion in the prior year quarter. Sands China Ltd. Consolidated Financial Results On a GAAP basis, total net revenues for SCL increased 1.4% to $1.93 billion, compared to the third quarter of 2025. Net income for SCL decreased 29.8% to $191 million, compared to $272 million in the third quarter of 2025. 2 Other Factors Affecting Earnings Interest expense, net of amounts capitalized, was $186 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $187 million in the prior year quarter. Our weighted average debt balance was $15.53 billion during the third quarter of 2026, compared to $15.94 billion during the third quarter of 2025. Our weighted average borrowing cost was 4.7% during the third quarter of 2026, compared to 4.5% during the third quarter of 2025. Our effective income tax rate for the third quarter of 2026 was 22.5%, compared to 15.6% in the prior year quarter. The income tax rate for the third quarter of 2026 was primarily driven by a 17% statutory rate on our Singapore operations. Stockholder Returns During the third quarter of 2026, we repurchased $950 million of our common stock (approximately 21 million shares at a weighted average price of $45.31). The remaining amount authorized under our share repurchase program was $5.06 billion as of September 30, 2026. Since the resumption of our share repurchase program in the fourth quarter of 2023 through September 30, 2026, we have repurchased 19.0% of our outstanding shares, approximately 145 million shares of our common stock at an average price of $48.03, for a total investment of $6.98 billion. The timing and actual number of shares to be repurchased in the future will depend on a variety of factors, including the company’s financial position, earnings, legal requirements, other investment opportunities and market conditions. During the third quarter of 2026, we purchased 62 million shares of SCL common stock for HKD 793 million (approximately $101 million at exchange rates in effect at the time of the transactions), increasing the company’s ownership percentage of SCL to 75.56% as of September 30, 2026. We paid a quarterly dividend of $0.30 per common share during the quarter. Our next quarterly dividend of $0.30 per common share will be paid on November 10, 2026, to Las Vegas Sands stockholders of record on November 2, 2026. Balance Sheet Items Unrestricted cash balances as of September 30, 2026 were $2.86 billion. 3 The company has access to $4.27 billion available for borrowing under our U.S., SCL and Singapore revolving credit facilities, net of outstanding letters of credit, and $4.57 billion available under a delayed draw term loan facility that may be used to finance development and construction costs, expenses, fees and other payments related to the MBS Expansion Project. As of September 30, 2026, total debt outstanding, net of deferred offering costs and original issue discounts, excluding finance leases, was $15.30 billion. Capital Expenditures Capital expenditures during the third quarter totaled $281 million, including construction, development and maintenance activities of $154 million in Macao, $121 million at Marina Bay Sands and $6 million in corporate and other. ### Conference Call Information The company will host a conference call to discuss the company’s results on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time. Interested parties may listen to the conference call through a webcast available on the company’s website at www.sands.com. About Sands (NYSE: LVS) Sands is the leading global developer and operator of integrated resorts. The company’s iconic properties drive valuable leisure and business tourism and deliver significant economic benefits, sustained job creation, financial opportunities for local businesses and community investment to help make its host regions ideal places to live, work and visit. Sands’ portfolio of properties includes Marina Bay Sands® in Singapore and The Venetian® Macao, The Londoner Macao®, The Parisian® Macao, The Plaza® Macao and Four Seasons® Hotel Macao, and Sands® Macao in Macao SAR, China, through majority ownership in Sands China Ltd. Dedicated to being a leader in corporate responsibility, Sands is anchored by the core tenets of serving people, communities and the planet. The company’s ESG leadership has led to inclusion on the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Indices for World and North America, as well as Fortune’s list of the World’s Most Admired Companies. reference.summary: Las Vegas Sands Corp., together with its subsidiaries, owns, develops, and operates integrated resorts in Macao and Singapore. It owns and operates The Venetian Macao Resort Hotel, The Londoner Macao, The Parisian Macao, The Plaza Macao and Four Seasons Hotel Macao, and The Sands Macao in Macao, the People's Republic of China; and Marina Bay Sands in Singapore. The company's integrated resorts feature accommodations, gaming, entertainment and retail malls, convention and exhibition facilities, celebrity chef restaurants, and other amenities. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.
